_about: The remake's dungeon doors, keys and chests in OoTR's logic (dungeons plugin; evidence per location). Every rule is at least as strict as the game. Water Temple: 4 locked doors, all off the main room: D1 the central pillar's 1F door (middle-water Triforce, Obj_WaterTemple_StoneTablet_A_03, and the pillar basement), D2 2F west (room 10: the geyser up to the high-water Triforce, StoneTablet_A_02), D3 3F west (falling platforms, Dark Link, Longshot), D4 1F north (north basement, boss key). 4 keys: Torches (room 18) and Dragon (room 8) need no door; Cracked Wall (room 4, behind the 2F east cracked wall: bombs, Iron Boots, the underwater switch and geyser lid) and Central Bow Target (room 20: the 2F north eye switch, Longshot, Iron Boots) need middle water. Door counts are OoTR-style worst cases (a door needs enough keys to open it even if every other locked door reachable without it took one first): with keys shuffled anywhere D1 needs 3 (D3 can be opened first from the floats at the starting high water, D4 with a Longshot found elsewhere; D2 needs middle water, which is behind D1) and D2, D3, D4 need all 4; with vanilla keys only D4 can be opened before D1 (it needs the Longshot), so D1 needs 2 and D2 3. The Map is in room 17 beside the low-water Triforce (StoneTablet_A_01), reached at the starting high water: no Raise_Water_Level (which needs keys here). The Compass is in room 3 behind the 1F south cracked wall (South Basement); the River chest does not exist. North basement (room 14): break the walls and push block 71436 onto switch 05458 to raise the water to the upper door; no Hover Boots or ledge route (dungeon audit). Bottom of the Well: 2 locked doors (the two inner Gold Skulltula rooms) and 2 keys; no bombable walls, no Like Like chest, no front-centre chest; the room-11 chest across a hidden pit behind the Lullaby crawlspace is new. Gerudo Training Ground: the maze is OoT's (7 locked doors on the left path to the Ice Arrows, 2 on the right), traced from its wall models, so OoTR's maze counts hold; the freestanding key is a chest in the right-hand maze room; the Like Like room's gate is opened by a Lens eye switch (Bow); its bomb chest is behind a cracked wall; the lobby's left chest is an invisible chest; the room's fifth chest falls from the ceiling when its eye switch is shot (GerudoTrainingGround_10_FallTreasureBox). Spirit Temple: the sun-block room's 5 silver rupees (room 9, counter 47443) open the door to the hall (room 10), its key door, the Silver Iron Knuckle and the child-side hand (DesertColossus exit 82023): the Silver Gauntlets chest and the hands need them; the child early-torches chest stands behind the fence (Obj_SpiritTemple_FallNet_B_01) its 5 silver rupees drop (its rule here is its one rule: room 1's east door reaches room 4's north part without room 2's Boomerang bridge, and the net bridges to the chest; the Boomerang for the spots only reached over that bridge is in audit_dungeons.json, G4). Ganon's Castle: 1 locked door (light trial room 13 -> boulder room 14) and 1 key, in a new invisible chest in room 13. Forest Temple: OoT's Map chest room has no chest. Proven absent (no chest in the remake's files there, none in the remake guides), so removed from logic: Dodongo's Cavern Boss Room, Shadow Temple Falling Spikes Upper (the room has two chests: the lower one and the upper key chest, OoTR's Switch chest, same rule as Upper) and Invisible Spikes, Spirit Temple Child Climb East and Statue Room Northeast, Ganon's Castle Spirit Trial Invisible, Bottom of the Well Like Like and Front Center Bombable, Water Temple River. Vanilla contents that differ from OoT: tools/rando/parity/dungeons.py (data/rando/dungeons_world.json vanilla_items).
